parts.name: Rotation Blade
parts.Basic_description: This is the rotation blade of a folding knife, made of stainless steel. It is a thin, sharp component designed for cutting.
parts.Functional_description: The blade performs the cutting function of the knife. It can rotate around a pivot point to fold into or out of the base body for safety and portability.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around a hinge or pivot joint, allowing it to fold into the handle when not in use.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body (handle) of the folding knife, made of aluminum alloy. It provides structural support and a grip for the user.
parts.Functional_description: The base body houses the rotation blade when folded and provides a comfortable and secure grip during use.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during operation, serving as the main support structure for the rotating blade.
